blurb: Offers classes in Classical Chinese dance technique including barre work and center exercises to improve flexibility, coordination, and posture. Classes include learning about Chinese culture and history through folk dances from 56 ethnic minority groups. The syllabus is recognized by both Chinese and Canadian governments and runs from grade 1 to 13, awarding high school credits upon completion.
